intro: Birmingham's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $101/month, down 1.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Birmingham metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $105, down 3.5% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $127. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $47 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$52.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $66 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$78. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $101, down 1.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Birmingham metro non-climate asking rent $105, down 3.5% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Birmingham alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$127.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $137 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$172.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $171 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$222.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Chapel Hill (~$86), South East Lake (~$88), Huffman (~$97) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Southside Birmingham (~$262) is among the highest.
Birmingham has about 68 facilities and 7.9 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 56,700 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026 (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
